verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so published speed metrics such as tokens per second, latency figures, benchmarks or load-testing guides are a fair thing to ask of it. The evidence pack contains none of these. Its docs cover API compatibility, regions, pricing per service tier and capabilities such as streaming, but no performance numbers or benchmark material. Streaming support is a related feature, not published evidence backing a speed claim.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
